conditions: The input character sequence is a literal CRLF or a CR not followed by LF in an external parsed entity.
limitations: The specification includes the document entity. Character references are interpreted later.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: XML 1.0 Fifth Edition requires processors to behave as if they convert literal CRLF and lone CR in external parsed entities to a single LF before parsing.
